alternates.headline: Arafat returns to Gaza after 27 years in exile

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Near East & South Asia, No. 127, 1 July 1994
evidence.snippet: …t time for the arrival of brother Yasir Arafat, Abu-’Ammar, is 1430 [1130 GMT] at the Rafah crossing point. Naturally, God only knows the time needed for Arafat to travel between the Rafah crossing point and the city of Gaza. However, ‘Arafat will arrive at the Rafah crossing point at 1430 tomorrow, Friday, God willing. {Mu’addi] Dr. Nabil: What is the program prepared for Yasir “Arafat, and will he pay a visit to the Jericho area? {Sha’th]…
